run_kmeans_codebook: run wav2vec_cluster_faiss.py to compute kmeans codebook from wav2vec features using FAISS
parse_faiss_specs: parse a FAISS spec string like PCAx_NORM_CLUSx_SPHERICAL into structured clustering parameters
run_feature_extraction: run wav2vec_cluster_faiss.py to extract features from audio files listed in a TSV file
review_Wav2VecFeatureReader: review the Wav2VecFeatureReader class that loads wav2vec checkpoints and extracts layer features from audio
run_pca_clustering: run wav2vec_cluster_faiss.py with PCA dimensionality reduction and spherical kmeans clustering on wav2vec features
